name: Shenzhen Techwinsemi Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Techwinsemi Technology Co., Ltd. focuses its operations on the design, research, development, and practical deployment of integrated circuits. The company's core activities include engineering and enhancing flash memory controller chips. Furthermore, it creates and optimizes application solutions for storage modules, which it then distributes to the market. Established in 2008, the firm is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
